svg.title: Entitlements: adapter selection sequence
svg.desc: Sequence of adapter selection. Existing assignments reuse their saved binding. New assignments match local routes, discover qualified instances, resolve a scoped client, verify the target and commit the binding before dispatch.
svg.text: ENTITLEMENTS / ADAPTER SELECTION
Select once. Reuse the saved binding.
Input: an authorized assignment and the capability profile from accepted purchase terms.
alt
Binding exists: reuse the saved instance
else
No binding: select and save one
Entitlements
State store
Types Registry
ClientHub
Adapter
Find saved binding
Binding or absent
Resolve client by saved instance ID
Saved scoped client
Match one route from local configuration
Capability + profile + authorized scope + service type, when required
Discover eligible instances for this route
Instance IDs, supported profiles and priorities
Check qualification and choose the unique lowest priority
No match or tied best priority: stop; no provider call
Resolve client by selected instance ID
Scoped client
Verify expected provider target, scope and observation authority
Verified identity, or stop on mismatch
Check route version;
save binding + work
Committed
Both paths continue through the saved binding
Send apply / read request with the saved binding and current authority
Result for the original operation, revision and digest
Save result
Route changed before commit? Repeat selection. Failed validation? Do not dispatch.
Existing assignments never switch adapters on an outage.
The adapter checks the target and revision fences before any OSS effect.
